import pytest

from shoplib.errors import ShopError
from shoplib.storedays import daily_revenue


def test_store_day_boundary_and_timezone_conversion():
    sales = [
        {"at": "2026-11-17T19:59:00Z", "cents": 100},  # 03:59 local, previous store day
        {"at": "2026-11-17T20:00:00Z", "cents": 200},  # 04:00 local, new store day
        {"at": "2026-11-18T06:00:00+02:00", "cents": 300},  # 12:00 local
    ]

    assert daily_revenue(sales) == [
        ("2026-11-17", 100),
        ("2026-11-18", 500),
    ]


def test_sales_days_include_gaps_and_refunds():
    sales = [
        {"at": "2026-11-18T04:00:00+08:00", "cents": 1200},
        {"at": "2026-11-20T03:59:00+08:00", "cents": -200},
    ]

    assert daily_revenue(sales) == [
        ("2026-11-18", 1200),
        ("2026-11-19", 0),
        ("2026-11-20", -200),
    ]


def test_no_sales_returns_empty_list():
    assert daily_revenue([]) == []


def test_timestamp_without_timezone_raises_value_error():
    with pytest.raises(ShopError):
        daily_revenue([{"at": "2026-11-18T04:00:00", "cents": 100}])
